aboutPage.heroSubtitle: More than a mountaineering agency, we are a community of mountain enthusiasts
aboutPage.missionDesc: To make the high-altitude mountaineering experience accessible to people of all levels, with safety, professionalism, and passion.
aboutPage.visionDesc: To be the leading mountaineering expedition agency in Mexico, recognized for the quality of our experiences and our commitment to safety.
aboutPage.valuesDesc: Safety first, respect for the mountain and the environment, and commitment to the personal growth of every climber.
aboutPage.storyP1: Adventures GI was born from a passion for mountaineering and the desire to share the magic of the most impressive summits in Mexico and the world.
aboutPage.storyP2: Founded in Mexico City, our agency has guided hundreds of climbers to their first summits, from the volcanoes of central Mexico to the most challenging peaks of South America.
aboutPage.storyP3: Every expedition is designed with attention to detail, prioritizing safety and the unique experience of standing on top of the world.
aboutPage.teamSubtitle: Certified guides with years of high-altitude experience
aboutPage.ctaTitle: Ready to meet us on the mountain?
aboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Join our next expedition and discover why hundreds of climbers trust us.
aboutPage.metaDescription: Meet the Adventures GI team, certified guides passionate about mountaineering in Mexico and the world.

ceoPage.name: Giovanna Venegas Rangel
ceoPage.title: Founder & CEO
ceoPage.bioTitle: A life dedicated to the mountains
ceoPage.bioP1: Giovanna Venegas Rangel is a passionate mountaineer and certified guide who has dedicated her life to the most impressive mountains of Mexico and the world.
ceoPage.bioP2: With years of high-altitude experience, Giovanna founded Adventures GI with a clear mission: to make high-altitude mountaineering experiences accessible to people of all levels, from beginners to experienced climbers.
ceoPage.bioP3: Her philosophy is that the mountain is for everyone. With the right preparation, the right equipment, and the guidance of certified professionals, anyone can live the transformative experience of reaching a summit.
ceoPage.achievement2: Summited the highest peaks in Mexico
ceoPage.achievement3: International expeditions in Ecuador and Peru
ceoPage.philosophyQuote: The mountain does not distinguish between beginners and experts. What matters is passion, preparation, and respect for nature. My mission is to accompany you on every step toward your summit.
ceoPage.ctaSubtitle: Discover our expeditions designed with Giovanna's vision and experience.
ceoPage.metaTitle: Giovanna Venegas Rangel — CEO of Adventures GI
ceoPage.metaDescription: Meet Giovanna Venegas Rangel, founder and CEO of Adventures GI, a passionate mountaineer and certified high-altitude guide.
